models.name: Krea 2 Turbo
models.description: 12B general-purpose model by Krea, strong at photoreal and varied styles. SlopTweak sets it to 8 steps and CFG 1 when Invoke opens. Needs a 24 GB GPU and a host with plenty of RAM, so it rents for more than the anime models. Also installs the SNOFS LoRA (adult-content LoKR by Ashen3, v1.4, 1.5 GB), which needs a CivitAI key; add it from the LoRA panel in Invoke to use it.
models.license_note: Krea 2 Community License: free for personal use and for businesses under $1M/yr revenue. It asks you to take reasonable steps against generating prohibited or unlawful content.

models.name: Kroma Turbo
models.description: Community fine-tune of Krea 2 (by lodestones) with its own look; prompts don't always carry over from Krea 2. SlopTweak sets 8 steps and CFG 1 when Invoke opens; up to 12 steps and CFG 1.5 also work. Largest download in the list (31 GB, so the GPU can take 15+ minutes to get ready) and needs a GPU with 32 GB or more, about $0.50-0.65/hr, so raise the price limit in Settings to about $0.70.

models.name: Wulver Turbo
models.description: Krea 2 fine-tune (v0.5, by Vaelico) for anthro/furry art with anime and kemono styles, multi-character scenes, and 1,113 artist styles you call as @artistname. Start prompts with a rating tag (sfw, ...), then the artist, then a detailed description; long prose works best. SlopTweak sets 8 steps and CFG 1 when Invoke opens. Same size as Kroma: a 27 GB download (the GPU can take 15+ minutes to get ready) and a GPU with 32 GB or more, about $0.50-0.65/hr, so raise the price limit in Settings to about $0.70.
models.license_note: Krea 2 Community License plus Krea's Acceptable Use Policy (the model is a modified Krea 2): free for personal use and for businesses under $1M/yr revenue. It asks you to take reasonable steps against generating prohibited or unlawful content.
